prior_summary: Destination-centered action diffusion expresses TCP position as a world-axis offset from the observed red_goal, targeting translated-pad placement and consistent pad-relative descent/release.
applicable_conditions: Prefer when the drawer is open, red is acquired or near acquisition, and a displaced but reachable red_goal or pad-relative placement accuracy is the dominant variation.
termination_guidance: Continue through red descent, opening, and clearance, then through the retained blue acquisition overlap; nominally hand off after red stays on the pad and blue/TCP initial-lift co-motion is visible.
limitations: Goal-relative output does not solve a far-displaced red pickup, collision, grasp failure, a moving goal inside a chunk, or blue displacement. Goal relocation was not observed in training.
